title: Mystic Apothecary Sorcerer
description: A blue-skinned sorcerer in ornate green robes and a tall red conical hat sits at a desk reading an ancient tome. Behind him floats a giant cosmic bear-like entity with glowing green eyes, multiple arms, and orbiting rings, set within a dark mystical apothecary filled with glowing lanterns and shelves of potions.
prompt: A blue-skinned wizard wearing intricate green robes and a tall spiraling red hat sits at a wooden desk reading a glowing book inside a dark apothecary shop. Behind him looms a massive floating cosmic bear deity with multiple arms, glowing green eyes, white mask-like face, and orbiting rings of light. Shelves filled with potion bottles, hanging red and green paper lanterns, floating papers and mystical symbols fill the scene under a dark blue draped curtain with serpents.
